sources.query: SELECT GL_ACCOUNT_WID, MCAL_PERIOD_WID, LEDGER_WID, GL_JE_SOURCE_WID, GL_JE_CATEGORY_WID, POSTED_DATE, FUND_VALUE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, FED_NON_FED, TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE, TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, D_C_INDICATOR, AMOUNT, JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, RECORD_CATEGORY, GL_PERIOD, BALANCE_TYPE, TRADING_PARTNER_ID, PERIOD_NAME, EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, DOLLAR_AMOUNT, REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, DACT_REPORT_IND, PIID, PARENT_AWARD_ID, FAIN, URI, DOC_NUM, DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, INTEGRATION_ID, CREATED_ON_DT, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, EVENT_ID, DELETE_FLG, TP_OPDIV, TP_LEDGER_WID FROM POC.W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F

/* CORRECTED expected recompute -- supersedes the prior draft's NOTE 1/NOTE 2. The prior draft assumed the mapping-level (design-time) 'Sql Query' override on SQ_W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS -- which injects W_MCAL_DAY_D.ROW_WID AS POSTED_DT_WID and W_FV_TP_TREASURY_SYMBOLS_D.ROW_WID AS TRADING_PARTNER_WID ahead of POSTED_DATE, shifting every port from POSTED_DATE onward by 2 -- was what actually executes. It is NOT: all four sessions carry a SESSION-level per-partition SQL Query override (Partition #1 of each; partitions 2-4 are dummy 'WHERE 1=2') that replaces the mapping-level override at runtime. That override selects exactly 46 columns 1:1 aligned with the SQ's 46 ports (no shift) and derives AID/ATA/MAIN_ACCOUNT/SUB_ACCOUNT from a real join through W_GL_ACCOUNT_D.TREASURY_SYMBOL_WID -> W_TREASURY_SYMBOL_D (CURRENT_FLG='Y'), not NULLs. PowerCenter uses the partition-level override in preference to the mapping-level one, so there is no live column-shift defect -- all passthrough/WID columns below are expected to match exactly (0 differences). TP_OPDIV / TP_LEDGER_WID are modeled as NULL placeholders here and marked ignoreColumn in DataCompare 3: HHS_mplt_SIL_GTAS_Get_TP_Ledger_WID's v_TP_OPDIV is NULL unless AID='075' AND TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID='075' (outer IIF has no else-branch); when that gate is true the value comes from a 4-way cascading fallback (LKP_TP_MAIN_ACCT_OPDIV_MAPPING / LKP_MAIN_ACC_OPDIV / LKP_MAIN_ACC_OPDIV_CNT / LKP_MAIN_ACC_OPDIV_CNT_LST), each configured 'Lookup policy on multiple match = Use Any Value' (non-deterministic on ties) against W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D / W_CFRS_ORG_XWALK_D. That branch isn't safely reproducible as a deterministic recompute and is instead exercised by DataCompare 6, which asserts only the deterministic NULL branch (gate = false). */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT FS.CCID, FS.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, FS.PERIOD_YEAR, FS.PERIOD_NUM, FS.JE_SOURCE, FS.JE_CATEGORY, FS.POSTED_DATE, FS.FUND_VALUE, FS.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, FS.AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, FS.FED_NON_FED, FS.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE, FS.TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, FS.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, FS.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, FS.BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, FS.D_C_INDICATOR, FS.AMOUNT, FS.JE_HEADER_ID, FS.JE_LINE_NUM, FS.RECORD_CATEGORY, FS.GL_PERIOD, FS.BALANCE_TYPE, FS.TRADING_PARTNER_ID, FS.PERIOD_NAME, FS.EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, FS.DOLLAR_AMOUNT, FS.REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, FS.DACT_REPORT_IND, FS.PIID, FS.PARENT_AWARD_ID, FS.FAIN, FS.URI, FS.DOC_NUM, FS.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, FS.AE_HEADER_ID, FS.AE_LINE_NUM, FS.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, FS.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, FS.INTEGRATION_ID, FS.CREATED_ON_DT, FS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, FS.EVENT_ID
  FROM POC.W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS FS
)
SELECT
  GLACC.ROW_WID AS GL_ACCOUNT_WID,
  MCAL.ROW_WID AS MCAL_PERIOD_WID,
  LGR.ROW_WID AS LEDGER_WID,
  JES.ROW_WID AS GL_JE_SOURCE_WID,
  JEC.ROW_WID AS GL_JE_CATEGORY_WID,
  B.POSTED_DATE,
  B.FUND_VALUE,
  B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
  B.AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE,
  B.FED_NON_FED,
  B.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE,
  B.TRADING_PARTNER_NAME,
  B.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID,
  B.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT,
  B.BUDGET_IMPACT_IND,
  B.D_C_INDICATOR,
  B.AMOUNT,
  B.JE_HEADER_ID,
  B.JE_LINE_NUM,
  B.RECORD_CATEGORY,
  B.GL_PERIOD,
  B.BALANCE_TYPE,
  B.TRADING_PARTNER_ID,
  B.PERIOD_NAME,
  B.EXCEPTION_CATEGORY,
  B.DOLLAR_AMOUNT,
  B.REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE,
  B.DACT_REPORT_IND,
  B.PIID,
  B.PARENT_AWARD_ID,
  B.FAIN,
  B.URI,
  B.DOC_NUM,
  B.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
  B.AE_HEADER_ID,
  B.AE_LINE_NUM,
  B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID,
  B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME,
  B.INTEGRATION_ID,
  B.CREATED_ON_DT,
  B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
  B.EVENT_ID,
  'N' AS DELETE_FLG,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS TP_OPDIV,
  CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,0)) AS TP_LEDGER_WID
FROM base B
LEFT JOIN POC.W_GL_ACCOUNT_D GLACC ON B.CCID = GLACC.INTEGRATION_ID AND B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = GLACC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND GLACC.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN POC.W_LEDGER_D LGR ON B.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID = LGR.INTEGRATION_ID AND B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = LGR.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_MCAL_PERIOD_D MCAL ON B.PERIOD_YEAR = MCAL.MCAL_PERIOD AND B.PERIOD_NUM = MCAL.MCAL_YEAR AND B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = MCAL.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_GL_JE_SOURCES_D JES ON B.JE_SOURCE = JES.INTEGRATION_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_GL_JE_CATEGORIES_D JEC ON B.JE_CATEGORY = JEC.INTEGRATION_ID

/* Scenario 2 (actual): rows scoped to the DETERMINISTIC branch of the TP_OPDIV gate -- i.e. NOT (AID='075' AND TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID='075') -- where v_TP_OPDIV's outer IIF has no else-branch and must be NULL, independent of the non-deterministic 4-way crosswalk fallback used only on the '075' branch. */
SELECT F.JE_HEADER_ID, F.JE_LINE_NUM, F.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, F.TP_OPDIV, F.TP_LEDGER_WID
FROM POC.W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F F
JOIN POC.W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS FS
  ON F.JE_HEADER_ID = FS.JE_HEADER_ID AND F.JE_LINE_NUM = FS.JE_LINE_NUM AND F.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = FS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_GL_ACCOUNT_D GLACC ON FS.CCID = GLACC.INTEGRATION_ID AND FS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = GLACC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND GLACC.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN POC.W_TREASURY_SYMBOL_D TSD ON GLACC.TREASURY_SYMBOL_WID = TSD.ROW_WID AND TSD.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
WHERE NOT (NVL(TSD.TREASURY_DEPT_CODE,'~') = '075' AND NVL(FS.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID,'~') = '075')

/* Scenario 2 (expected): same population as JDBC 4, independently re-derived from source+dimension data (not the target table), asserting TP_OPDIV/TP_LEDGER_WID = NULL. */
SELECT FS.JE_HEADER_ID, FS.JE_LINE_NUM, FS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS TP_OPDIV, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(15,0)) AS TP_LEDGER_WID
FROM POC.W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS FS
LEFT JOIN POC.W_GL_ACCOUNT_D GLACC ON FS.CCID = GLACC.INTEGRATION_ID AND FS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = GLACC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND GLACC.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN POC.W_TREASURY_SYMBOL_D TSD ON GLACC.TREASURY_SYMBOL_WID = TSD.ROW_WID AND TSD.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
WHERE NOT (NVL(TSD.TREASURY_DEPT_CODE,'~') = '075' AND NVL(FS.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID,'~') = '075')
